Hi Priya / Liam,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. Short recap attached (PDF) and pasted below — let me know if anything looks off: 

- Inference latency: median token latency down to 220ms (baseline 1.1s) across typical 128-token prompts
- Throughput: sustained 450 reqs/min on a single dedicated instance (x3 improvement vs baseline infra)
- Cost per 1K tokens: estimated $0.085 after batching/kv-cache tweaks (approx 62% reduction)
- Accuracy: F1 on retrieval-augmented answers improved from 0.71 -> 0.84 on your eval set

We'd love to feature Catalyst Retail as a short customer quote and 10–15 minute advocate call to include in a brief case study. Two asks:
1) Would you be comfortable with a 1–2 sentence quote we can publish mentioning the performance/cost wins?
2) Would either of you be open to a 10–15 min call next week for a quick soundbite and to approve copy?

I attached the one-page metrics brief (catalyst_poc_metrics_may03.pdf) and a dashboard screenshot. If you'd prefer an anonymized quote, we can do that too.

If it helps, suggested short quote options are in the attachment — feel free to edit.

Thanks — Jordan
